commentary: The portfolio is anchored by three secular themes with confirmed momentum and fundamental support: AI infrastructure (CPAY, LRCX, MU capturing payments tech, semiconductor equipment, and memory), quality financial compounders at discount (RNR, V, NU spanning reinsurance, global payments, and EM fintech), and defensive healthcare franchises trading at undemanding multiples (NBIX, EXEL, SYK). Energy exposure via EQT reflects the durable AI/data-center power demand tailwind, while Industrials (NVT, TT) capture the electrification and HVAC build-out cycle. Sector caps are satisfied across all 8 sectors; cash residual of ~1% provides flexibility.

picks.rationale: Payments infrastructure compounder: 20.7% revenue growth, 29.1% ROE, 80% gross margins at only 10.4x forward PE — the forward/trailing PE gap signals a sharp earnings ramp ahead.
Lam Research rides the AI-driven WFE cycle with 23.8% revenue growth, 40.8% earnings growth, and 66.8% ROE; momentum +61% 6M confirms institutional accumulation.
Micron is in an AI memory super-cycle with 196% revenue growth, 41.5% margins, and only 5x forward PE — deeply discounted given HBM demand runway.
RenaissanceRe Q1 2026 beat with strong operating income; trades at 5.5x trailing / 7.5x forward PE with 19.7% ROE and 27.6% revenue growth — textbook value with catalyst.
Visa's wide-moat network compounds at 14.6% revenue growth with 50.2% profit margins and 53.9% ROE; 1M momentum +10.3% signals re-accumulation at 21.3x forward PE.
Nubank delivers 60.9% earnings growth and 43.9% revenue growth at 12.6x forward PE as LatAm digital banking penetration accelerates; 30.3% ROE validates the premium.
Neurocrine trades at 9.68x forward vs 27.4x trailing PE on 47.7% earnings growth and 28.3% revenue growth — the Ingrezza franchise is materially undervalued.
Exelixis delivers 84.2% earnings growth, 96.4% gross margins, 35.5% ROE at only 11.4x forward PE; Cabometyx label expansion and Merck setback reinforce the bull case.
Stryker's 55.9% earnings growth and 65% gross margins in defensive medical devices with $4.2B FCF; -18.7% 6M drawdown creates a re-entry opportunity at 19.2x forward PE.
Largest US natural gas pure-play with $2.5B FCF, 80.97% gross margins, and 49.9% revenue growth; AI/data-center power demand is a structural tailwind at 12.6x forward PE.
Booking Holdings at 14x forward PE with 38.4% earnings growth and $6.6B FCF despite a 16% 6M drawdown; summer 2026 travel season and international expansion are catalysts.
Edison International at 10.4x forward PE with 5.12% dividend yield, 30.8% revenue growth, and 24.1% ROE; rate normalization compresses the yield gap as 6M momentum +29.2% confirms re-rating.
nVent's 41.8% revenue growth and 11.1x earnings growth reflect direct AI/data-center liquid cooling and electrical protection demand; 51% 6M momentum validates the electrification thesis.
Trane Technologies compounds via data-center HVAC and refrigerant transition tailwinds with 36.96% ROE and $1.94B FCF; steady 13.7% and 14.1% momentum signals quality accumulation.
WD-40 provides defensive ballast via global brand moat, international distribution expansion, and pricing power; small allocation satisfies sector diversification in a risk-on portfolio.

rationales.CPAY: CPAY is undervalued at a 10.45x forward P/E despite 20.7% revenue growth, 29.1% ROE, and 79.7% gross margins, with $1.89B in free cash flow providing significant capital flexibility. The forward/trailing P/E gap signals a sharp earnings ramp ahead, and rate-cut tailwinds support further multiple expansion.
rationales.LRCX: LRCX is positioned to compound on AI-driven semicap demand with 23.8% revenue growth, 40.8% earnings growth, and 66.8% ROE backed by $4.35B free cash flow. Momentum is overwhelming (+61% over 6 months) and the 32x forward PE is justified by 50% gross margins and a transformative IBM partnership.
rationales.MU: Micron is firing on all cylinders with revenue growth of 196.3%, profit margins of 41.5%, and ROE of 39.8%, yet trades at a forward P/E of just 4.99 — a deep disconnect for a semiconductor leader riding the AI memory super-cycle. HBM capacity ramps and DRAM pricing power support continued multiple expansion.
rationales.RNR: RNR's Q1 2026 earnings beat on lower expenses and strong investment results confirms operational health, while it trades at only 5.54x trailing P/E and 7.53x forward P/E with 27.6% revenue growth and 19.7% ROE. Low beta of 0.24 offers defensive re-rating potential.
rationales.V: Visa's wide-moat payments network delivers 14.6% revenue growth, 17.4% earnings growth, and elite 50.2% profit margins supported by $22B in free cash flow. The 1-month momentum of +10.3% signals renewed institutional accumulation at 21.3x forward PE.
rationales.NU: Nubank's 60.9% earnings growth and 43.9% revenue growth, paired with a 30.3% ROE and 41% profit margins, demonstrate LatAm fintech scaling at exceptional pace. The forward P/E of 12.6 versus trailing 25 signals massive earnings acceleration ahead.
rationales.NBIX: Neurocrine trades at a compelling forward P/E of 9.68 despite delivering 28.3% revenue growth and 47.7% earnings growth, with $398M in free cash flow and 62.7% gross margins. The valuation gap between trailing P/E and forward P/E implies a sharp earnings ramp the fundamentals already validate.
rationales.EXEL: Exelixis offers a compelling growth-at-reasonable-price setup with 84.2% earnings growth, 96.4% gross margins, and a forward P/E of just 11.35 against $631M in free cash flow and 35.5% ROE. Cabometyx label expansion and Merck setback reinforce the competitive position.
rationales.SYK: Stryker's 11.4% revenue growth, 65% gross margins, and 55.9% earnings growth signal accelerating operating leverage in a defensive medical devices franchise. The 18.7% 6-month drawdown creates an attractive entry point for this low-beta compounder generating $4.17B in free cash flow.
rationales.EQT: EQT is the largest US natural gas pure-play trading at 12.55x forward PE with 49.9% revenue growth, 35.07% profit margins, and $2.5B in free cash flow. AI/data-center power demand is a structural multi-year tailwind with 80.97% gross margins supporting durable earnings power.
rationales.BKNG: Booking Holdings trades at a forward P/E of just 14.0 despite 38.4% earnings growth and 16% revenue growth, with elite 87.4% gross margins and $6.55B in free cash flow. The summer 2026 travel season and continued international expansion are near-term catalysts.
rationales.EIX: Edison International trades at a deeply discounted 10.42x forward P/E with a 5.12% dividend yield, delivering 30.8% revenue growth and 24.1% ROE. The 6-month momentum of +29.2% confirms institutional re-rating as the rate-cut cycle favors high-yield regulated utilities.
rationales.NVT: nVent's electrical infrastructure business delivers 41.8% revenue growth and 11.1x earnings growth, driven by AI/data-center liquid cooling and electrical protection demand. The 51% 6-month momentum confirms institutional accumulation at a reasonable 27.9x forward PE given growth.
rationales.TT: Trane Technologies is a high-quality HVAC compounder riding secular tailwinds in decarbonization and data center cooling, with elite 36.96% ROE and $1.94B in free cash flow. Momentum of +13.7% 1M and +14.1% 6M signals quality accumulation at 28.5x forward PE.
rationales.WDFC: WD-40's defensive consumer staples profile and global brand moat provide portfolio ballast in risk-off scenarios. International distribution expansion and pricing power as input costs normalize are the primary catalysts for this low-volatility allocation.
